summary: Master the principles of Integrated Water Resources Management. This training course equips you with the tools to tackle global water challenges effectively.
lede: Integrated water resources management training is for professionals coordinating water, land and related decisions across a basin or service area. Learners practise basin mapping, water supply-and-demand assessment, pollution and ecosystem-pressure analysis, and stakeholder evaluation to prioritize interventions. Exercises produce practical tools such as allocation scenarios, stakeholder matrices and monitoring plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate water, land, environmental, infrastructure, and community decisions across a basin or service area. It is suitable for foundation-to-intermediate learners with practical exposure to water, environmental, infrastructure, or natural resource work.
prerequisites: No advanced hydrological modelling or programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with water, environmental, infrastructure, agriculture, utility, or natural resource operations and be comfortable reviewing tables, maps, and simple performance indicators. Coding is not required. You should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises and digital dashboard work.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
